title: Warped in Dishwasher ? never got to use even once ?
text:
Warped in Dishwasher ? never got to use even once ?. Bought for my wife. She's a clean freak so first thing she wanted to do was put them in the dishwasher.
All of them warped and cannot be used now. So disappointed, and noticed there is nothing on the webpage about this ? Only in the fine print manual does it say NOT DISHWASHER SAFE

Please add "" NOT DISHWASHER SAFE to your product description
